documents: The beam selection experiment uses sub-6 GHz observations to choose a near-field beam at the high-frequency array. Reliability is measured as the chance that the optimal beam is included in a predicted candidate set.
An order service deletes its Redis cache entry after committing a PostgreSQL transaction. A retry queue handles failed invalidations to reduce stale reads.
The inference engine uses eight-bit quantization for transformer weights. Quantization reduces weight storage and may introduce numerical error.
A conformal predictor calibrates nonconformity scores on an exchangeable calibration set. Its prediction set achieves marginal coverage under the stated exchangeability assumption.
The scheduler assigns Kubernetes Pods to nodes based on resource requests and constraints. A taint repels Pods unless an appropriate toleration is present.
The optical sensor measures glucose through a fluorescent response. The calibration curve maps measured intensity to concentration and is affected by temperature.
A fault-tolerant log replicates entries to a majority of nodes before committing. A leader proposes new records and followers acknowledge replication.
A battery test holds discharge current constant while recording terminal voltage. Capacity is obtained by integrating current over discharge time.
A hash join builds an in-memory hash table on its smaller input. The larger input probes this table to find equal join keys.
A seismometer records ground motion as a time series. The P wave normally reaches the station before the S wave because it travels faster.
The image segmentation network predicts one class label for each pixel. Intersection over union divides the intersection of predicted and reference masks by their union.
A compiler performs constant folding by evaluating expressions whose operands are known at compile time. Dead code elimination removes operations that cannot affect observable behavior.
The wind-tunnel experiment varies angle of attack while measuring lift and drag. Stall occurs when flow separation causes lift to decrease sharply.
A randomized trial allocates participants to treatment and control groups. Random assignment reduces confounding on average, while blinding helps reduce measurement bias.
The graph algorithm uses a priority queue to select the unvisited vertex with smallest tentative distance. Nonnegative edge weights are required for the Dijkstra correctness argument.
The storage system uses erasure coding with data and parity shards. It reconstructs missing shards when enough surviving shards are available.
A chromatography column separates molecules based on different interactions with stationary and mobile phases. Retention time is measured from injection to the observed peak.
A language model uses a key-value cache to avoid recomputing previous attention keys and values during autoregressive decoding. Cache memory grows with sequence length.
An access-control system grants permissions to roles and assigns roles to users. Least privilege gives each role only permissions needed for its work.
A telescope photometer measures brightness across consecutive observations. A periodic dip in a star light curve can indicate a transiting planet.
A differential privacy mechanism adds calibrated random noise to limit how much one individual changes an output distribution. The privacy parameter epsilon controls the permitted privacy loss.
The robot estimates its pose from inertial measurements and camera features. Sensor fusion combines complementary information to reduce uncertainty compared with either source alone.
An event-driven service publishes immutable events to a broker. Consumers track offsets so they can resume processing after a restart.
The thermal model solves heat conduction with boundary temperatures prescribed at the domain edges. A finer spatial mesh reduces discretization error but increases computation.
